title: US 52 over Mud Creek
source_note: 2020-03-27 Stage 3 · DRAFT / NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION · Exterior detail modeling candidate
assumptions: The public document is a design draft, not final as-built plans. This model reconstructs that drawing version. A separate 12-page scanned plan set for the existing bridge is available and is not mixed with the new design.
Internal reinforcing bars, tendons and embedded hardware are excluded. Fabrication details absent from the drawings are not claimed as reconstructed.
Colors distinguish components. Individual volumes may overlap at assembly boundaries and must not be summed as a quantity takeoff.
The default view hides the LMC overlay to expose 24 panels and their joints. Enable the overlay layer to view the finished surface.
Elevation 910.80 ft is assigned local vertical coordinate 0. The 135 ft vertical curve and +/-0.5% tangents are modeled parabolically.
Deck, railings and bedding layers are separate model components. Their descriptions identify actual monolithic or precast integration where known.

detail_coverage.detail: Spans 27 + 36 + 27 ft; deck 91 ft 6 in by 40 ft 4 in; 2% crossfall and 135 ft vertical curve.

Separately modeled 24 modules, 8 in longitudinal joints, 12 in transverse pier joints and 13 in abutment joints. Module length follows p39: 26 ft 2 in, distinguished from the p38 overview's 27 ft 3 in notation. Joint profiles and embedded pockets are simplified.
Includes 8 modules per pier with vertical UHPC, rounded wall ends, segmented end bents with the 9 in pavement ledge and 4 wingwalls. Internal pile pockets are shown as filled envelopes.

Each approach includes 6 panels and connections, with the 4 ft 1 in x 1 ft 6 in outer corner cutbacks. FC railing sections follow sheet 51 (top corner radii omitted); the TFC transitions are 15 ft 8 in long (sheets 53, 55) and use the FC section of sheet 53 section A-A, their curvature is omitted. The 6 ft sleeper slabs sit as in sheet 59 section B-B; their 2 ft lug step is simplified.
Internal reinforcement, pile lengths, embedded lifting devices, lane markings, continuous roadway and fine surface texture are excluded.

corrections.approach_corner_cutbacks: 4 ft 1 in x 1 ft 6 in at the four outer corners; approach railings end at the cutback; sleeper slabs 37 ft 4 in wide
corrections.fc_railing_section: 2 ft 9 in high, 2 in rear setback, 9 in top, 3 in toe (sheet 51); also used for the approach transitions (sheet 53 section A-A)
corrections.approach_railing_base: lowered 1 1/2 in onto the precast edge panels
corrections.railing_joints: closure pours fill 13 in / 12 in; 1/2 in neoprene joint outside the 91 ft 6 in bridge railing, modelled as an open joint
corrections.support_names: Abutment 1 / Abutment 2 renamed End Bent 1 / End Bent 4 (manifest names only)

known_deviations.deviation: Seat El. 929.48 at the edges and 929.89 at the centre (ledge 8 in higher) against plan El. 929.21 / 929.61 (ledge 929.88 / 930.28); the bottom is at plan El. 926.21, so the cap is about 3.3 in deeper than drawn.
known_deviations.reason: The draft plans conflict: the sheet 23 seat plus 1 in bed, 20 in slab and 1 1/2 in overlay gives El. 931.485 at the bent, the sheet 21 profile El. 931.76. The model keeps the deck on the profile and the cap bottom on sheet 23.

known_deviations.deviation: Wingwall tops at El. 929.88 (3 ft 8 in high, sheets 23-24) are about 2.8-3.9 in below the approach slab soffit less the 1 in UHPC bed of sheet 53 section A-A, and about 3.3 in below the corrected end-bent ledge.
known_deviations.reason: Same datum conflict as end-bent-absolute-elevation; not resolved from the draft plans.

known_deviations.deviation: The 1/2 in neoprene expansion joint between the bridge railing and each approach transition is an open 1/2 in gap; the filler is not a separate part.
known_deviations.reason: Joint filler, not a structural member.

known_deviations.deviation: The TFC transitions are 15 ft 8 in long as drawn on sheets 53 and 55; the sheet 9 roadway plan (item 1) gives sta. 457+58.08 to 457+71.25 and 458+62.75 to 458+75.92, 13.17 ft.
known_deviations.reason: The draft plans conflict; the structural detail sheets of the precast edge panel are followed.

known_deviations.deviation: The six barrier delineators sit across the railing top, mostly embedded in it; sheet 51 draws them on the upper front (traffic) face.
known_deviations.reason: Visualisation markers; their size and mounting height are not dimensioned on the drawings.

corrections.tfc_transition_length: 15 ft 8 in from the 1/2 in neoprene joint (|X| 13.9573..18.7325 m), ending 9 in short of the corner cutback (sheets 53, 55); was 16 ft 4 1/2 in to the cutback
corrections.sleeper_slab_position: 6 ft sleeper with the 2 ft lug beyond the 2 1/2 in joint at the approach slab end: |X| 19.0373..20.8661 m (sheet 59 section B-B, sheet 53 plan); was 19.2786..21.1074 m
corrections.end_bent_4_module_labels: Bent 4 = Bent 1 rotated 180 deg (sheet 23): module A on the north (+Y) side, module B on the south (-Y) side; labels only
